steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Hurry it up, everyone!

steps.name: Masked Villager
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Masked Villager
steps.text: You should run too, Ritou! Money isn't as important as your life.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: I'll delay the old man!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: What are you standing around for?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Can I take it you've given up on treating your sister?

steps.name: Masked Villager
steps.text: But... Alright.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Kusso...

steps.name: Lost Child
steps.text: *Sobbing*...

steps.name: Lost Child
steps.text: Mom? Where are you?

steps.name: Lost Child
steps.text: Where are you...

steps.name: Lost Child
steps.text: Mom... don't leave me here...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Flurry Rush!)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: In the nick of time!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is the child okay?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Let me see. All four limbs attached, no external wounds... does it hurt anywhere?

steps.name: Lost Child
steps.text: Ouch... your armor's spiky...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oops, sorry.

steps.name: Frenetic Villager
steps.text: My child!

steps.name: Lost Child
steps.text: Mom!

steps.name: Frenetic Villager
steps.text: Thank you... Thank you so much for saving my child!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Stay away from the forest. There are wild beasts in the area, and they're increasing in numbers. It's not safe here.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato... I don't think they came out here because they wanted to.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: No! There's netting between the village and the forest. I reinforced it myself not long ago. How could there be beasts here?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I need to go take a look.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Calm down. Has the evacuation started?

steps.name: Frenetic Villager
steps.text: No... There's no evacuation. The mine exploded, the sky started burning... there's nothing left.

steps.name: Frenetic Villager
steps.text: Everyone's running. We all panicked when we heard that beasts were coming, but we don't know where to go.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Why is it so chaotic? What happened?

steps.name: Frenetic Villager
steps.text: I tried to pull Naoki away from the crowd, but then a bunch of them ran straight at us. Naoki was gone by the time I caught my breath.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Someone intentionally damaged the netting, letting in the beasts.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Ano yarou... Where is Takii?

steps.name: Frenetic Villager
steps.text: The headman is—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Here they come again, Corne!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'll hold them off with my shield... Argh, whatever, a sword's fine!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kashiwau, please take these two to a safe place and see if you can help out in the village. Corne and I will stop the beasts.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I don't need you to tell me that. Let's go Mirai... Mirai?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I think she already went in.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: How could it have come so quickly? Wasn't it supposed to take more time for the Catastrophe to form?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Noshige, Inoue, get everybody together and take them to the shelter I told you about! It's safer there. We'll evacuate as a group once we have everybody!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Good thing we'd prepared for this day... What you said came true again.

steps.name: Despondent Villager
steps.text: It's burning...

steps.name: Despondent Villager
steps.text: The mountains are covered in smoke... the sky's on fire... the mine's gone...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What are you doing? Grab your things and get out of here!

steps.name: Despondent Villager
steps.text: My livelihood, my life, it's all gone...

steps.name: Despondent Villager
steps.text: Headman... will we have to go back to our old life, now that the mine's all burned up?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Now's not the time for that!

steps.name: Despondent Villager
steps.text: Gone... everything's gone...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Why are you panicking like that? The Catastrophe isn't even here yet.

steps.name: Panicking Villager
steps.text: Beasts! The beasts are coming!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Beasts! And so close! What happened to the protective netting?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ritou, get over here! What's going on over there?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Headman! The netting on the west side is broken! The beasts are in the village! What do we do?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What in blazes is going on here?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Everybody, calm down! Take the bare minimum of what you need, gather at the shelter in the northeast, and wait for evacuation! The beasts can't get in there.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Headman... why is there a shelter in the village?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Did you already know this was going to happen?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: This... happened because you closed the mine, didn't it?

steps.name: Panicking Villager
steps.text: H-Headman?

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Headman!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What you on about, Ritou? You know that isn't true!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: This is no time to be fooling around! Lives are at stake here!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Don't just stand there, folks! Head to the shelter!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: No, this is important! Everything we've worked for is gone! We need justice!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Why did the mine have to be closed? Why did this disaster happen right afterward?

steps.name: Panicking Villager
steps.text: Y-Yeah! You closed it for 5 days out of the blue for a 'maintenance check,' and now the mine's gone, and the whole mountain is burning!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Did you close the mine and keep the truth hidden from the others because of that monster that showed up down there? Is that the cause of this disaster?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: We could have worked together to deal with it!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: It was your idea to keep it a secret, to prevent a panic.

spans.text: idea to keep it a secret, to prevent a panic.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: And don't think I don't know about your little side business. I know how much you've pocketed ever since your family started handling the transactions.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: If you have the slightest bit of conscience left, stop delaying the evacuation!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Then how do you explain the shelter? You must have planned this in advance... You're the one who wants to hoard the wealth of the mine all to yourself!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: You even blew up the cave... You killed those two doctors who came to investigate the Oripathy!

steps.name: Inoue
steps.text: Headman...

steps.name: Noshige
steps.text: What did you do, Headman?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Not you too... Ritou...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Yes, I'll admit I've wanted to close the mine for a long time. I knew that overexploitation of the mine was bound to bring disaster. The shelter was built in preparation for this day.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Why? Because we're over-reliant on Originium mining. Originium particles have already entered the environment. The danger has been slowly building for a while now!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: It was only a matter of time before Catastrophe struck and we'd have to abandon the mine, but I couldn't get everyone to give up on it before. We all benefitted too much from the Originium trade.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: That day simply came a little sooner than expected, that's all.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: And yes, I closed the mine because of that unknown creature.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You all know that I used to be a hunter. I judged that it wasn't something we could easily handle, and we couldn't afford to fight it in the tunnels.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ishidori and the others have already been infected with Oripathy. People would have died if we'd continued to dig. The responsibility for all of your lives falls on my shoulders.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: ...Which is the same reason I'm telling you to evacuate now.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Mine or not, the most important thing is that we're alive.

steps.name: Sad Villager
steps.text: But then things would go back to how they used to be...

steps.name: Sad Villager
steps.text: Cold nights... howling in the forest... blood, cold, hunger... fear... no! I don't want to go back to that!

steps.name: Sad Villager
steps.text: So what if we're alive?! Where's the hope? I'd rather die than go back to living like that!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What are you saying... get ahold of yourself!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: He's right! We won't go back!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: It was you who got us started on mining Originium in the first place! It's all your fault!

steps.name: Sad Villager
steps.text: You ruined everything!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: You've ruined the village! Ruined all our lives!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: This man must be made to pay! We all agree, don't we?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Enough of this!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: There's a Catastrophe right on your doorstep!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Haven't we already paid enough of a price? Are we going to lose even more lives just for this meaningless venting?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Mirai! Why are you back?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Oh look, another troublemaker. The apple doesn't fall far from the tree.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: The frightened beasts are heading down the mountain, the netting's been sabotaged, and someone's trying to stir up chaos...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: All to force us to wait for death in despair, and abandon the hope we could have had.

steps.name: Sad Villager
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: And we still can have, away from the Originium mines, without having to rely on hunting either.

spans.text: have, away from the Originium mines, without having to rely on hunting either.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: That's why I came back from the city.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Liar! You were the one who wanted to close the mine and ruin our lives!

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Yes, because Originium is dangerous and hard to control. I even considered blowing up the mine.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: But I also understand that we owe our livelihood to it.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Do you remember back when we were trying to climb out of poverty? Were we in despair then?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Was it really the Originium that got us to where we are today?

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: We seized our chance to escape poverty because we had the determination to look for a way, and the courage to expose ourselves to Originium.

steps.name: Angry Villager
steps.text: Y... Yeah.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Since ancient times, hunters have made a living by fighting beasts, back when there was no Originium. Many of them died, but we survived as a people.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Courage and hope come hand-in-hand. And we've never abandoned our courage...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: So hope will always appear by our side.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Don't listen to her! She was the one who wanted to close the mine! And now she's destroyed the mine, she practically admitted it!

spans.text: Don't listen to her! She was the one who wanted to close the mine! And now she's
the mine, she practically admitted it!

steps.name: Stout Villager
steps.text: But Mirai only tried to convince us to close it because overexploitation would cause a Catastrophe. And now that really happened...

steps.name: Tall Villager
steps.text: We were wrong to doubt her...

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: You're familiar with the plant in this flask, aren't you? Among the goods that we trade with the outside, the Suzuka herb is second only to Originium in terms of trade volume.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It only grows in certain areas, and in small numbers. We've had to risk life and limb to harvest it.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: But I came back to study the possibility of cultivating it, and planting it outside its native habitat. This one I'm holding right here is my greatest breakthrough.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: It can survive outside of these mountains. It's the first brick that will lay the foundation of our future as a village.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: But first, we need to survive.

steps.name: Sad Villager
steps.text: Survive...

steps.name: No Longer Angry Villager
steps.text: Yeah, what were we thinking? We fought so hard to get to this point. We can't just die here.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: No! We'll lose all our income without the mine—

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Aah!

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Who... gah...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Open your mouth again, and I'm sticking your head in the mud.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: This entire conversation is a waste of time.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: This man damaged the netting, tried to lure in beasts to cause chaos, then distracted everyone from what was going on.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: While on the other side of the village, he had some people moving his assets out, something he clearly planned ahead of time. I've already taken care of them.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You will now head to the shelter in an orderly line and await evacuation. Reinforcements from Rhodes Island will be arriving soon.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Now, you can walk there yourselves, or I can knock you out and have someone else carry you. Choose.

steps.name: Mirai Takii
steps.text: Er... thank you.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: There's a beast outbreak, and they're approaching the village. That's the biggest threat we're facing right now.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We'll handle the beasts. I can't guarantee we'll get all of them, but we'll do what we can to ensure your safety.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: No, please stay here and protect the evacuating villagers. You're the only ones who can.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: And take care of Mirai for me.

steps.name: No Longer Angry Villager
steps.text: Headman! Where are you going?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I'm the headman of Roka Village, and the leader of its hunters.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: The beasts have emerged from their forests, so I'll fight them to my last breath, even if I'm on my own!

steps.name: No Longer Angry Villager
steps.text: Honey, take Tsuyumaru to the shelter.

steps.name: No Longer Angry Villager
steps.text: I think I left my machete in the backyard?

steps.name: Sad Villager
steps.text: Yes, it's there... come back safely!

steps.name: Stout Villager
steps.text: The headman's always treated our family well. It's high time we repaid him!

steps.name: Tall Villager
steps.text: Yes, we're with him, whether it's in the mines or in the forests. We've always been hunters. Take up your spears!

steps.name: Tall Villager
steps.text: We'll protect our own village and our own families!

steps.name: Stout Villager
steps.text: Headman! Wait for us!

steps.name: Bald Villager
steps.text: I'm going too!

steps.name: Frightened Child
steps.text: Mom, didn't dad said there were no hunters anymore?

steps.name: Resolute Villager
steps.text: No, Sumiko. The hunters have always been here, ready to step forward whenever danger approaches.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hmph... and now they're putting on a show. They're no hunters.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm the only one...
